build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: flight-authority::camera shared pilot controller (quaternion orbit, chase, pan, zoom, reset); old pilot and native vehicle view consume it; gestures/frames/look-at stay host-side
ownership.mit: existing render-core frames/instances and render-wgpu terrain/mesh/device/queue unchanged; no game logic moved into MIT crates
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt
ownership.readback_boundary: existing optional final captures and hardware test assertions read back; no runtime per-frame scene readback

camera_contract.state: unit quaternion orbit, chase flag, 8..180m distance, +-4m pan; shipped defaults (tilt -0.18rad, 32m) and gesture factors preserved
camera_contract.gestures: right-drag orbit 0.005rad/px, middle-drag pan 0.0018m/px/m, wheel exp(-lines*0.09), keyboard yaw 0.05rad, multiplicative zoom factors, Backquote-equivalent reset preserving chase
camera_contract.math: verbatim legacy basis (chase craft columns with parenthesized negation; survey north/east with pole fallback), orbit composition, pan-target eye and 0.12 look-down shift
camera_contract.failure_boundary: non-finite demands ignored (state kept); degenerate frames return None and hosts keep the previous view; overflow zoom clamps far like the legacy clamp
camera_contract.host_split: old client converts offsets to Bevy Transform in the render/craft-local frame; native recovers body-frame craft orientation from the published mesh instance and stages body-space ViewParams with the survey perspective
camera_contract.survey_boundary: terrain-only survey view keeps the legacy angle orbit (map-view analogue); shared camera never moves it, preserving the terrain-only A/B workload
camera_contract.physics_boundary: camera gestures provably never touch FlightAuthority; trajectory identity vs direct authority holds with gestures applied between advances

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians on the untouched survey path; no speedup claimed, no adapter tax isolated

runs.name: flight-sweep
runs.note: sweep now yaws the shared orbit (0.006rad/frame); survey angle untouched in vehicle mode

preview.name: preview
preview.note: default orbit azimuth faces the unlit broadside at the polar-night site; framing verified broadside-centered at 32m (cos(view,nose)=0); yawed diagnostics show the lit side; no ambient manufactured (pre-existing direct-only boundary)

live_offscreen.boundary: full existing local physics demand + presentation/streaming/terrain/mesh/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and final readback; not isolated renderer/camera cost or game FPS
live_offscreen.comparison_boundary: different camera cover between orbit/chase/sweep; not equal-scene runs and not Bevy parity; trajectory (not pixels) is the cross-mode identity

camera_microbenchmark.boundary: basis/orbit/pan/eye/target math and timer/barriers; no physics, ephemeris, assets, streaming, GPU upload/render or waits

native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS; chase framing active throughout

captures.meaning: normal terrain-only new-1 HUD regression frame; survey framing unchanged
actual local authority at 10.5s through the owned orbit pilot camera
identical completed authority state in chase framing following craft attitude
frozen epoch preview through the owned orbit camera; default azimuth faces the unlit broadside (polar night, direct-only light); framing verified centered broadside at 32m
legacy unpaused local-fallback pilot on the shared camera path; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not equal-scene parity

legacy_bevy_smoke.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=pilot THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: embedded server executable absent: existing local fallback; ALSA/JACK diagnostics; old pilot consumes the shared FlightCamera through its Bevy Transform path; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not audio/network validation or equal-scene parity

verification.new_regressions: shared controller defaults/factors/clamps/reset/chase, invalid-demand no-op, bit-exact offsets vs verbatim legacy math, ported chase layout, polar pole traversal, survey independence, gesture/physics separation, finite fallbacks; old-pilot shared-path chase/spawn/pole pins; native orbit/chase GPU renders; --chase/help CLI validation; HUD/no-HUD terrain, live-flight and chase window lifecycle
verification.review: local camera/pose ownership, framing migration exactness, fail-closed handling, survey workload preservation, host gesture/clock boundaries and GPL/MIT separation

limitations: Local diagnostic flight host only: no native network/fleet receive loop, prediction/reconciliation, player flight commands, production flight UI or full client lifecycle replacement.
Survey/map camera still legacy; only the pilot/vehicle view migrated. Materials remain base-color/Lambert without PBR/shadows/atmosphere parity.
Preview/framing captures are not visual acceptance or equal-scene Bevy parity.
No device-loss recovery, persistent conforming GPU bisector topology or FastRT acceleration structures are established by this slice.
